decisions.reason: The transactional email service is a flagship of the firm's cloud messaging direction, shown on the home page, and fits growing demand for high-volume compliant email.
Managed capture has a dedicated page and documented customer adoption, and it supports the firm's move toward electronic document workflows.
Email-to-fax conversion serves regulated sectors where fax is still used and costs little to maintain, though fax demand is slowly declining.
The fax delivery optimization feature is integrated into the core fax service, so keeping it costs little and adds reliability value for existing customers.
Sandbox threat protection addresses rising ransomware risks and is a key part of the firm's email security suite.
